chapter: Dancing schools and Charlie Johnson in New York
title: Living in Harlem; his wife Freddi
summary: McRae rented the first floor of a private house on 137th Street and sent for his wife, a fellow church member, and they married in New York.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Where were you living at this time when you were living in New York?

I was living -- I think I was living -- I was living at 137th Street. Rented a whole first floor from the people that had a private home. Then I stayed there until I sent and got (inaudible) my wife, Freddi Bowen (inaudible), her name is Freddi (inaudible). She was a church member. We used to go to church together and I sent for her and we got married here in New York. After I came out of that dancing school, Chick was fooling around getting his band together, you know. But I didn't come out of the dancing school -- When I left the dancing school, that was June, we came to the club -- what's that club
